issues.description: Default turn_detection_mode change is a silent breaking change for existing users
issues.detail: Changing the default from EXTERNAL to FIXED alters end-of-turn behavior for any existing integration that relied on the documented default. There is no deprecation path or migration note in code. Users who upgrade will see different endpointing behavior with no warning, only a changelog line.

issues.description: Switching to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame breaks non-VAD pipelines that previously triggered finalize
issues.detail: Previously process_frame finalized on UserStoppedSpeakingFrame; now only VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame triggers finalize. Pipelines without a VAD producing that specific subclass (e.g., manual UserStoppedSpeakingFrame) will silently stop finalizing transcriptions. This is a behavior regression for any user not running a VAD analyzer that emits the VAD-specific frame.

issues.description: _enable_vad check uses EndOfUtteranceMode but default change uses TurnDetectionMode.FIXED
issues.detail: _enable_vad is computed from end_of_utterance_mode, not turn_detection_mode. The PR adds FIXED to the exclusion list for EndOfUtteranceMode, but it's unclear whether EndOfUtteranceMode.FIXED exists or maps consistently with TurnDetectionMode.FIXED. If the enum lacks a FIXED member, this raises AttributeError at import/init time. Verify both enums were updated.

issues.description: speech_segment_config always overwritten, ignoring any prior SDK defaults
issues.detail: config.speech_segment_config = SpeechSegmentConfig(emit_sentences=params.split_sentences or False) unconditionally replaces whatever the SDK or earlier config set. If users have other SpeechSegmentConfig fields configured upstream, they will be silently reset. Consider only setting emit_sentences when split_sentences is not None, or merging onto the existing config.

issues.description: Warning log fires for the wrong condition
issues.detail: The warning 'VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame received but internal VAD is being used' implies the frame should not arrive when internal VAD is on, but VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame is emitted by Pipecat's VAD analyzer regardless of the Speechmatics setting. Logging a warning on every turn when internal VAD is enabled will spam logs.

issues.description: Commented-out metrics call moved but not removed
issues.detail: The line `# await self.start_processing_metrics()` was simply relocated above the broadcast call rather than deleted or implemented. Dead commented code should either be enabled with intent or removed entirely; leaving it as a moved comment adds noise and signals incomplete work.

review.summary: The PR introduces a meaningful behavior change by switching the default turn_detection_mode to FIXED and finalization to VADUserStoppedSpeakingFrame, but lacks migration guidance and may silently break pipelines that emit the non-VAD UserStoppedSpeakingFrame. The _enable_vad check mixes EndOfUtteranceMode and TurnDetectionMode enums, which needs verification. SpeechSegmentConfig is unconditionally overwritten, and there are minor concerns with warning log noise and moved-but-not-removed dead code.
